items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I like Bach. I like Bach for the precision, the sort of mathematical precision.

ctx.x: What type of literature was she working you through?
All the standard literature, Bach, Beethoven, pieces by lesser composers, but all in the classic vein. I didn’t get into jazz until years later.
Did you have a particular affinity for any classical composers?
